quote: to reduce LDL-C in adults with hypercholesterolemia, including heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH)
note: NEXLETOL single-ingredient label names HeFH directly.

quote: Septicemia and Endocarditis caused by susceptible Gram-positive organisms
note: Single-ingredient ampicillin label covers septicemia/Gram-negative sepsis; neonatal sepsis is a subtype.

quote: Infections caused by Chlamydia trachomatis such as uncomplicated urethral, endocervical or rectal infections, inclusion conjunctivitis
note: Single-ingredient tetracycline label covers chlamydial infections.

quote: lead poisoning (acute and chronic) and lead encephalopathy
note: Edetate calcium disodium single-ingredient label names lead encephalopathy.

quote: reduce the risk of acute urinary retention (AUR)
note: Single-ingredient dutasteride label names acute urinary retention.

quote: Treatment of Moderate to Severe Symptoms of Vulvar and Vaginal Atrophy due to Menopause
note: Vulvar and vaginal atrophy due to menopause is the older name for GSM and is on single-ingredient estradiol labels.

quote: topical treatment of persistent facial erythema associated with rosacea in adults
note: Single-ingredient oxymetazoline cream label names facial erythema.

quote: rheumatoid arthritis, including juvenile rheumatoid arthritis
note: Listed on single-ingredient prednisone label.

quote: Exfoliative dermatitis
note: Listed among dermatologic diseases on single-ingredient dexamethasone label.

quote: psoriatic arthritis; rheumatoid arthritis, including juvenile rheumatoid arthritis
note: Single-ingredient prednisone label lists multiple arthritides (rheumatic disorders).

quote: improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus
note: Single-ingredient saxagliptin label.

quote: Intra-abdominal Infections, including peritonitis caused by Escherichia coli
note: Single-ingredient ceftazidime label names intra-abdominal infections.

quote: Perennial and seasonal allergic rhinitis.
note: Single-ingredient promethazine label.

quote: Ibuprofen Tablets, USP are indicated for relief of mild to moderate pain.
note: Single-ingredient ibuprofen covers general mild-moderate pain; testicular pain is a specific pain type (weak but not a co-ingredient issue).

quote: For the treatment of dermatomyositis, temporal arteritis, polymyositis, and systemic lupus erythematosus.
note: Single-ingredient hydrocortisone label.

quote: body weight greater than 60 kg and obesity
note: Single-ingredient liraglutide (Saxenda) FDA and EMA labels cover chronic weight management in obesity.

quote: reduce the risk of acute urinary retention (AUR)
note: Single-ingredient dutasteride label; acute urinary retention is a subtype of urinary retention.

quote: indicated for treatment of Rocky Mountain spotted fever, typhus fever and the typhus group
note: Single-ingredient doxycycline label.

quote: psoriatic arthritis; rheumatoid arthritis
note: Listed on single-ingredient prednisolone label.

quote: Urinary Tract Infections (complicated and uncomplicated), including pyelonephritis and cystitis
note: Single-ingredient aztreonam label.

quote: Nicardipine hydrochloride capsules are indicated for the treatment of hypertension.
note: Single-ingredient nicardipine label.

quote: acute gouty arthritis, acute and subacute bursitis, acute nonspecific tenosynovitis
note: Only on the 'combination' label, but that product is betamethasone sodium phosphate + betamethasone acetate (two salts of DRUG itself), so attributable to betamethasone.

quote: allergic conjunctivitis, keratitis, allergic corneal marginal ulcers
note: Single-ingredient prednisolone label lists allergic conjunctivitis; atopic conjunctivitis is a subtype.

quote: Prevention of Postmenopausal Osteoporosis
note: Single-ingredient conjugated estrogens label (prevention indication).

quote: maintenance treatment of asthma in patients 6 years of age and older
note: Single-ingredient SPIRIVA RESPIMAT label covers asthma; late-onset asthma is a subtype (the combo STIOLTO is explicitly not for asthma).

quote: indicated for the treatment of homocystinuria to decrease elevated homocysteine blood concentrations
note: Single-ingredient betaine label.

quote: indicated for the reduction of ocular pain and burning/stinging following corneal refractive surgery
note: Single-ingredient ketorolac ophthalmic label (Acular LS) names ocular pain.

quote: Use Temporarily relieves minor pain
note: Single-ingredient topical lidocaine covers local pain generally; scar pain not named but is a local pain subtype, and combo lidocaine/menthol pain claims also stem from lidocaine.

quote: indicated for use in the treatment of allergic symptoms by immunotherapy in patients with a history of grass pollen allergy
note: No single-ingredient text; the mixed grass pollen extract's immunotherapy indication is attributable to each grass component including Phleum pratense (timothy), and SAR is the grass-pollen allergy symptom.

quote: Treatment of heart failure (NYHA class II-IV)
note: Single-ingredient candesartan label.

quote: to reduce the risk of major adverse cardiovascular events (cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, stroke, or coronary revascularization)
note: Single-ingredient NEXLETOL label (risk reduction of MI).

quote: for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic MSI-H or dMMR colorectal cancer (CRC)
note: Single-ingredient KEYTRUDA label.

quote: indicated for the acute treatment of migraine with or without aura
note: Single-ingredient rizatriptan label.

quote: Mild, uncomplicated allergic skin manifestations of urticaria and angioedema.
note: Single-ingredient promethazine label.

quote: For the management of edema and sodium retention when the patient is only partially responsive to, or is intolerant of, other therapeutic measures
note: Single-ingredient spironolactone label covers edematous conditions.

quote: Gonorrhea, acute uncomplicated (ano-genital and urethral infections in males and females) - due to Neisseria gonorrhoeae
note: Single-ingredient amoxicillin label (with resistance caveat).

quote: Emergency treatment of allergic reactions (Type I), including anaphylaxis, which may result from allergic reactions to insect stings, biting insects, foods
note: Single-ingredient epinephrine label names food-induced anaphylaxis.

quote: Haemophilus parainfluenzae, or Streptococcus pneumoniae
note: Single-ingredient ciprofloxacin label covers S. pneumoniae (an alpha-hemolytic streptococcus) infections; match is loose but not a co-ingredient artifact.

quote: bronchospasm associated with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) (including emphysema and chronic bronchitis)
note: Single-ingredient SEREVENT label names emphysema.

quote: It has also been found useful in the treatment of acute non-lymphocytic leukemia and the blast phase of chronic myelocytic leukemia.
note: Single-ingredient cytarabine label mentions CML blast phase.

quote: Treatment and prevention of osteoporosis in postmenopausal women
note: Single-ingredient alendronate label.

quote: Included within the category of homocystinuria are Cystathionine beta-synthase (CBS) deficiency 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate reductase (MTHFR) deficiency Cobalamin cofactor metabolism (cbl) defect
note: Single-ingredient betaine label names cbl defects.

quote: maintenance treatment of bronchospasm associated with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)
note: Single-ingredient SEREVENT label.

quote: Atopic dermatitis
note: Single-ingredient corticotropin (Purified Cortrophin Gel) label; atopic eczema = atopic dermatitis.

quote: indicated for the temporary relief of coughs and upper respiratory symptoms, including nasal congestion, associated with allergy or the common cold
note: Only on combination labels (single codeine label is pain only), but codeine is the antitussive component of promethazine/phenylephrine/codeine, so attributable to DRUG.

quote: Reduce total-C and LDL-C in patients with homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HoFH)
note: Single-ingredient atorvastatin label names HeFH and HoFH.

quote: Rheumatic fever and/or chorea —Prophylaxis with penicillin G benzathine has proven effective in preventing recurrence
note: Single-ingredient penicillin G label (prophylaxis).

quote: complicated urinary tract infections (cUTI) and pyelonephritis due to Escherichia coli
note: Single-ingredient ciprofloxacin label.

quote: useful for the treatment of seborrheic dermatitis of the scalp, dandruff and tinea versicolor
note: Single-ingredient selenium sulfide label covers scalp seborrheic dermatitis; infantile form is a subtype.

quote: Klebsiella pneumoniae , specifically bacteremia.
note: Single-ingredient polymyxin B label covers bacteremia/bloodstream infections.
